subject: Emergency rate band clarification for upcoming launch — temporary uplift request
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@clearlaunch.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: ClearLaunch Procurement <procurement@clearlaunch.io>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: temporary rate band increase for Monday launch

Hi Irene,

Quick note — we have a hard launch for a retail partner scheduled for Monday (06/22) and our ingest is expected to spike beyond the committed throughput. Our telemetry indicates a potential 3x uplift for a 48–72 hour window. Can Redwood provide a temporary rate band increase or burst allowance so our customers don't hit throttles?

Numbers (rough): current commit = 50k tokens/day; expected peak = ~150–200k tokens/day for ~72 hours. We can absorb costs but need clarity on rates and whether a retro true-up will apply. Also looping procurement for PO/timing.

Appreciate any fast guidance — this is high visibility on our side.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Head of Platform
ClearLaunch
[attachment: launch-traffic-forecast.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@clearlaunch.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: temporary rate band increase for Monday launch

Elena — thanks for the heads up and the forecast. We can support a temporary uplift but want to align on the operational and billing path. High-level options: 

- Short-term uplift (up to 72 hrs) as a provisional "burst window" with pro-rated usage charges at your committed tier rate + 20% uplift. No penalties beyond that; we will true-up on next invoice.
- One-time credit structure: if you need guaranteed headroom (not best-effort), we can provision reserved headroom for the window (flat fee + per-token overage capped) — this requires a brief addendum.
- Emergency soft-fallback: route non-critical traffic to a lower-cost model variant while critical traffic remains on your committed model (automated fallbacks).

To move fast, please confirm expected peak tokens/day and whether you need an SLA-backed headroom. I attached a short addendum template we can send to procurement for signature. If procurement signs by EOD Sunday we can provision a soft quota increase Monday morning.

Action: Elena — confirm peak and preferred option. Procurement — if you can review the addendum I attached we’ll start internal provisioning.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Director, Commercial
Redwood Inference
[attachment: proposed-uplift-addendum.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Elena Morales <elena@clearlaunch.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: temporary rate band increase for Monday launch

+1 on the provisional uplift. Operational note: we can immediately juice the routing policy to increase your quota to 200k tokens/day for 72 hours with a single internal change, provided procurement signs the addendum for the billing path.

Suggested commercial terms (fast-track):
- Window: 72 hours (2026-06-22 00:00 UTC — 2026-06-24 23:59 UTC)
- Provisioned peak: up to 200k tokens/day
- Billing: actual usage billed at committed tier rate; apply a one-time uplift fee equal to 20% of estimated overage to cover priority provisioning. If total overage exceeds estimate by >30%, we will cap exposure and notify.
- Discount: for this one-off, Redwood to apply a $4,000 credit if ClearLaunch signs a 12-month commit within 30 days (this is discretionary approval for this launch).

Irene — if this looks good I’ll prepare the quick redline and queue ops to provision Monday AM once addendum is executed. Elena — if procurement can return a signed addendum (DocuSign) by 18:00 PT Sunday, we’ll be green for Monday.

Ben Carter
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morales <elena@clearlaunch.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: ClearLaunch Procurement <procurement@clearlaunch.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: temporary rate band increase for Monday launch

Thanks — this works. Procurement has reviewed and will sign the addendum. Two quick asks before we execute:

1) Can you confirm how alerts will surface to our SREs if we approach the provisioned peak? We need at least 15-minute early warnings.
2) Can you confirm the invoicing path — will the one-time uplift fee show on next monthly invoice with a separate line item?

Procurement will return the signed DocuSign by 18:00 PT today. Please confirm ops will provision on receipt.

Cheers,
Elena
